title: Custom Floors Unlimited
description: Custom Floors Unlimited designs and installs high-quality, custom-made solid wood flooring. They specialize in creating unique designs. However, they do not specialize in ensuring their own security or the security of their customers' data. Therefore, we provide you with confidential HR/payroll documents, financial/tax documents, customer contracts and commercial transactions, supplier/legal/insurance files, and IT credentials. A data breach can lead to identity theft, financial fraud, loss of trade secrets and customer trust, regulatory/law enforcement fines, litigation, and reputational damage.
